# APNS CHANGE SCORES
To identify the latent class exhibiting the greatest and most stable symptom resolution within each APNS domain, classes were ranked using a robust recovery score calculated as the negative median longitudinal change divided by the interquartile range. Use of the interquartile range reduced the influence of within-class dispersion arising from heterogeneous completion and timing of the serial text message–based symptom surveys, as participant-level change scores were derived from the assessments closest to the ED visit and closest to the estimated 6-month follow-up timepoint for each participant.
```{r}
latent_class_survey_data <- read_csv(
  "Data/Metadata/Latent Class Data/Latent_Class_Scores.csv") %>%
  filter(PID %in% metadata$PID) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^Loss_", "Depression_", .x), starts_with("Loss_") )
# long-format
long_survey <- latent_class_survey_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -PID, names_to = c("APNS", "Day"), names_sep = "_", values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(Score = na_if(Score, ".") %>% as.numeric(),
         Day = suppressWarnings(as.integer(Day))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Score), !is.na(Day)) %>%
  mutate(APNS = if_else(APNS == "Avoid", "Avoidance", APNS),
         APNS = if_else(APNS == "Depression", "Loss", APNS))

# Compute ED (~earliest day) and ~6M (closest to ED + 183 days), then change(M6 - ED)
# there is an average of 182.6 days in 6 months 
change_scores <- long_survey %>%
  arrange(PID, APNS, Day) %>%
  group_by(PID, APNS) %>%
  summarise(
    Closest_Day_to_ED = min(Day),
    ED_Score = Score[Day == Closest_Day_to_ED][1],
    Closest_Day_to_M6 = Day[which.min(abs(Day - (Closest_Day_to_ED + 183)))],
    M6_Score = Score[Day == Closest_Day_to_M6][1],
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Change_Score = M6_Score - ED_Score)

# Get ED latent classes and pivot to long for merging
APNS_classes_long <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, APNS_ordered) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -PID, names_to  = "APNS", values_to = "Class")

# Keep only PIDs in your RNA cohort (if needed) and attach class
change_scores_with_class <- change_scores %>%
  left_join(APNS_classes_long, by = c("PID", "APNS")) %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered)) 

# summary by Domain x Class
change_scores_summary <- change_scores_with_class %>%
  filter(!is.na(Class)) %>%
  group_by(APNS, Class) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Median_Change = median(Change_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_Change = IQR(Change_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Resolution_Score = -Median_Change / IQR_Change,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(APNS, Class)

# export
write_csv(change_scores_summary, "Cohort Characteristics/Summaries/APNS Latent Trajectories Change Scores.csv")
```


# ODDS RATIO ANALYSIS 
Pairwise associations among APNS classifications were quantified to evaluate how often domains co-occurred within Chronic or Recovered group assignments. APNS classes were first mapped to domain-specific Chronic or Recovered reference levels, and participants were encoded into binary matrices reflecting whether each domain was classified as Chronic or Recovered. For each group, all domain pairs were compared using 2×2 contingency tables, with odds ratios estimated using Fisher or Wald methods depending on cell counts and FDR correction applied across all pairwise tests. Heatmaps of log(OR) values summarize the strength and direction of co-classification patterns, highlighting domains that tend to cluster together within Chronic and Recovered outcomes.
```{r}

# convert to long format 
APNS_classes_long <- metadata %>%
  factorize_domains(domains = APNS_ordered, classes = class_order) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, all_of(APNS_ordered)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols= -PID, names_to  = "APNS", values_to = "Class") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    APNS = as.character(APNS),
    recovered_ref  = recovered_groups[APNS],  
    chronic_ref = chronic_groups[APNS],     
    Recovery_Group = dplyr::case_when(
      Class == chronic_ref   ~ "Chronic",
      Class == recovered_ref ~ "Recovered",
      TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, APNS, Class, Recovery_Group)

# map APNS classes to Chronic / Recovered groups 
APNS_classes_long <- metadata %>%
  factorize_domains(domains = APNS_ordered, classes = class_order) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, all_of(APNS_ordered)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -PID,
    names_to  = "APNS",
    values_to = "Class") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    APNS = as.character(APNS),
    recovered_ref = recovered_groups[APNS],
    chronic_ref = chronic_groups[APNS],
    Recovery_Group = dplyr::case_when(
      Class == chronic_ref   ~ "Chronic",
      Class == recovered_ref ~ "Recovered",
      TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, APNS, Class, Recovery_Group)


# function to compute pairwise ORs across APNS
compute_or <- function(binary_matrix) {
  domain_vars <- setdiff(names(binary_matrix), "PID")
  
  tidyr::expand_grid(APNS_A = domain_vars, APNS_B = domain_vars) %>%
    dplyr::filter(APNS_A != APNS_B) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate({
      a <- binary_matrix[[APNS_A]]
      b <- binary_matrix[[APNS_B]]
      tab <- table(A = a, B = b)
      
      if (all(dim(tab) == c(2, 2))) {
        expected <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)$expected)
        
        if (any(expected < 5) || any(tab == 0)) {
          test <- "Fisher"
          f    <- fisher.test(tab)
          or_val <- as.numeric(f$estimate)
          log_or <- ifelse(is.finite(or_val) && or_val > 0, log(or_val), NA_real_)
          ci_low <- f$conf.int[1]
          ci_high <- f$conf.int[2]
          p_val <- f$p.value
        } else {
          test <- "Wald"
          o    <- epitools::oddsratio.wald(tab)
          or_val <- o$measure[2, 1]
          log_or <- ifelse(is.finite(or_val) && or_val > 0, log(or_val), NA_real_)
          ci_low <- o$measure[2, 2]
          ci_high <- o$measure[2, 3]
          p_val <- o$p.value[2, 1]
        }
      } else {
        test   <- NA_character_
        or_val <- NA_real_
        log_or <- NA_real_
        ci_low <- NA_real_
        ci_high <- NA_real_
        p_val  <- NA_real_
      }
      
      tibble::tibble(
        Test = test,
        OR = or_val,
        log_OR = log_or,
        CI_low = ci_low,
        CI_high = ci_high,
        p_value = p_val)}) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(FDR_pvalue = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"))
}


## function to build binary matrix for a given Recovery_Group 
make_binary_matrix <- function(classes_long, group_label, col_name) {
  classes_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!col_name := ifelse(Recovery_Group == group_label, 1L, 0L)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(PID, APNS, !!col_name) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from  = APNS, values_from = !!col_name,values_fill = 0L)
}


# Chronic
chronic_binary_matrix <- make_binary_matrix(
  classes_long = APNS_classes_long,
  group_label  = "Chronic",
  col_name = "Chronic_Binary")

# Recovered
recovered_binary_matrix <- make_binary_matrix(
  classes_long = APNS_classes_long,
  group_label  = "Recovered",
  col_name = "Recovered_Binary")

chronic_or_results <- compute_or(chronic_binary_matrix)
recovered_or_results <- compute_or(recovered_binary_matrix)

```

## Plot 
```{r}
plot_chronic_OR <- chronic_or_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    APNS_A = factor(APNS_A, levels = rev(APNS_ordered), labels = rev(APNS_labels)),
    APNS_B = factor(APNS_B, levels = APNS_ordered, labels = (APNS_labels)),
    row_id = as.numeric(APNS_A),
    col_id = as.numeric(APNS_B)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(row_id + col_id <= length(APNS_ordered) + 1)

plot_recovered_OR <- recovered_or_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    APNS_A = factor(APNS_A, levels = rev(APNS_ordered), labels = rev(APNS_labels)),
    APNS_B = factor(APNS_B, levels = APNS_ordered, labels = APNS_labels),
    row_id = as.numeric(APNS_A),
    col_id = as.numeric(APNS_B)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(row_id + col_id <= length(APNS_ordered) + 1)

# shared color limits across heatmaps 
common_limits <- range(c(plot_chronic_OR$log_OR, plot_recovered_OR$log_OR), na.rm = TRUE)

# shared diverging fill scale
or_fill_scale <- scale_fill_gradient2(
  name = "log(OR)",
  low = "#A9674D",
  mid = "#F7F5F0",
  high = "#684B8A",
  midpoint = 0,
  limits = common_limits,
  na.value = "grey90"
)

# heatmaps 
chronic_heatmap <- ggplot(plot_chronic_OR, aes(x = APNS_B, y = APNS_A, fill = log_OR)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +
  or_fill_scale +
  geom_text(data = plot_chronic_OR %>% dplyr::filter(FDR_pvalue < 0.01),
            aes(label = "*"), color = "black", size = 5, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Chronic Classifications", x = "", y = "")

recovered_heatmap <- ggplot(plot_recovered_OR, aes(x = APNS_B, y = APNS_A, fill = log_OR)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(data = plot_recovered_OR %>% dplyr::filter(FDR_pvalue < 0.01),
            aes(label = "*"), color = "black", size = 5, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.7) +
  or_fill_scale +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size =12),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Recovered Classifications",x = "", y = "")


# combine plot
combined_heatmap <- ggarrange(chronic_heatmap,recovered_heatmap, ncol = 2, align = "hv", common.legend = FALSE, labels = c("a", "b"), font.label = list(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"))

ggsave("Odds Ratio Analysis/Plots/Odds Ratio Heatmap.jpg", plot = combined_heatmap, height = 3, width = 8, dpi = 500)

```

## Export
```{r}
chronic_or_export <- chronic_or_results %>%
  mutate(APNS_A = factor(APNS_A, levels = APNS_ordered),
         APNS_B = factor(APNS_B, levels = APNS_ordered), 
         across(where(is.numeric), format_num))

recovered_or_export <- recovered_or_results %>%
  mutate(APNS_A = factor(APNS_A, levels = APNS_ordered),
         APNS_B = factor(APNS_B, levels = APNS_ordered), 
         across(where(is.numeric), format_num))

out_file <- "Odds Ratio Analysis/Summaries/APNS_Odds_Ratio_Analyses.xlsx"

OR_wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(OR_wb, "Chronic_OR")
addWorksheet(OR_wb, "Recovered_OR")

writeData(OR_wb, "Chronic_OR", chronic_or_export, withFilter = FALSE)
writeData(OR_wb, "Recovered_OR", recovered_or_export, withFilter = FALSE)

# styles
header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_center <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_left <- createStyle(halign = "left", valign = "center")
border_style <- createStyle(border = "TopBottomLeftRight", borderStyle = "thin", 
                            borderColour = "grey80")

apply_styles <- function(sheet, df) {

  # header
  addStyle(OR_wb, sheet, header_style,
           rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df), gridExpand = TRUE)

  addStyle(OR_wb, sheet, border_style,
           rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  # body 
  addStyle(OR_wb, sheet, body_center,
           rows = 2:(nrow(df) + 1),
           cols = 1:ncol(df), gridExpand = TRUE)

  # left-align APNS labels
  addStyle(OR_wb, sheet, body_left,
           rows = 2:(nrow(df) + 1),
           cols = which(names(df) %in% c("APNS_A", "APNS_B")),
           gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  # borders for body
  addStyle(OR_wb, sheet, border_style,
           rows = 2:(nrow(df) + 1),
           cols = 1:ncol(df),
           gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  freezePane(OR_wb, sheet, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(OR_wb, sheet, cols = 1:ncol(df), widths = "auto")
}

apply_styles("Chronic_OR", chronic_or_export)
apply_styles("Recovered_OR", recovered_or_export)

saveWorkbook(OR_wb, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
```
